name: com.manabattery.framepacing
description: Draws the mb-framepacing frame marker (a QR code carrying the frame index and animation time) into every frame, so a capture of the display output can measure animation error. Includes the SDK's general C# marker module (MB.FramePacing.Marker) and Unity helpers.

samples.description: Pans the camera and brackets it with start and end markers.
